text: The exact three-line README and supporting documentation were successfully written and read back. Post-edit drift is clean and both affected-document obligations are resolved. args.summary: Stage 7 firmware applicability is NOT APPLICABLE for the actual captured analog hardware: the ten fitted components use seven explicitly reviewed non-firmware symbol types. Created and read back firmware/README.md with exactly the three required nonblank lines and a concrete hardware-only explanation; no MCU, dummy source, executable, build or toolchain result was fabricated. Added docs/FIRMWARE.md and the current SPEC evidence paragraph, recorded the decision/constraint and resolved both affected-document obligations. Fresh native ERC and BOM/PINOUT drift are clean; all 11 library/power-template definitions match; legibility has zero errors and one disclosed advisory. The native placement/routing DRC gate is clean with four intrinsic J1 hole_clearance findings separately retained, not raw-zero DRC. Hardware, BOM and exported source files are unchanged. All conditional budgets, manufacturing limitations and physical tests remain unqualified, and the original Stage 8 bring-up/development plan remains to be completed.
